protocol.purpose: Regression after human-confirmed 7-word hallucination. Independent 109-entry activity check; no threshold search. 3.649 seconds of annotated dev vocals lost; 50 original ASR dev inputs unchanged. English test has been inspected, not a blind test.

notes: Regression on previously inspected test data, not a new blind test. Local activity filtering has documented losses of real isolated vocals on dev data. The baseline was unseeded; small ASR differences cannot all be attributed to the filter.
